content.text:
Clean. JS-only change — just reload Metro, no rebuild.

What changed in `src/modules/inventory/screens/ScannerScreen.tsx`:
- Added `useIsFocused` from `@react-navigation/native`.
- `<Camera isActive>` is now `isActive={isFocused}`.

Why the previous attempt didn't work: pinning a format addresses *stream* problems, but the symptom — fails only on re-entry, on every device — is a *lifecycle* problem. Native-stack keeps the previous screen mounted when you `push`, so after `Scanner → Receiving` the camera session was still running in the background. Returning to Scanner re-rendered `<Camera isActive>` against an already-configured session and the library rejected the reconfigure as invalid. Tying `isActive` to focus tears the session down on push and rebuilds it cleanly on pop, which is the pattern vision-camera's docs recommend for React Navigation.
